prerequisite_ci_evidence.workflow: ULSH-01 WP2 physical transaction no-solve contract

confirmed_strengths: CP01R1 run id and frozen payload digest are source-bound
a_F remains exactly 1/4 and the historical a_F=0 control override is excluded from the target path
the deterministic 7-seed x 5-node-level schedule is fixed at 35 planned primary entries
primary, primary-base and independent backend raw-file hashes are checked before future execution
dependency, resource and result-schema sources are content-addressed
release authorization and single-use grant artifacts are absent
single-use spend uses exclusive creation and permanent replay denial
WP2 audit and CI paths execute zero numerical solver calls

blocking_findings.title: PER_SEED_PER_LEVEL_TIMEOUT_NOT_ENFORCED
blocking_findings.observed: WP2 transaction enforces only the total wall-clock alarm; the 1800 s per seed/per node-level limit is not applied around each planned schedule entry.
blocking_findings.risk: A single preregistered stage can violate the frozen resource envelope while the transaction still remains under the six-hour total budget.
blocking_findings.closure_condition: Add deterministic per-entry timeout enforcement with the frozen timeout_action and no retry/method change.

blocking_findings.title: MAXIMUM_RESULT_BYTES_NOT_ENFORCED
blocking_findings.observed: WP2 binds the 1 GiB result budget in the contract but does not enforce it while staging or committing execution artifacts.
blocking_findings.risk: A future execution could exceed the preregistered result budget without fail-closed classification.
blocking_findings.closure_condition: Enforce a cumulative artifact byte budget before atomic commit and preserve a classified partial/failure record without replay.

blocking_findings.title: MANDATORY_RESULT_AND_QA_ARTIFACT_CLOSURE_MISSING
blocking_findings.observed: The current target returns a compact raw matrix record. It does not preserve enough state and QA channels to instantiate all required primary_backend, independent_backend, candidate_inventory and acceptance_audit fields after the solve.
missing_or_not_closed: per-seed/per-level convergence history in final schema form
all eight boundary residuals per retained root
last-eight spectral coefficient audit at N=96
diagnostic singular-value/condition data sufficient for the declared result schema
candidate profile artifacts and their SHA-256 digests
machine-readable final classification under the frozen vocabulary
blocking_findings.risk: A physical solve could consume the single-use grant and then produce an evidentially unusable raw output that cannot be reconstructed into the preregistered result record.
blocking_findings.closure_condition: Capture the mandatory channels during execution and atomically instantiate or losslessly stage a schema-complete result package before any release is granted.

blocking_findings.title: MACHINE_ATTESTATION_INCOMPLETE_FOR_FROZEN_REPRODUCIBILITY_POLICY
blocking_findings.observed: WP2 runtime attestation records Python, dependency versions, thread environment and logical core count, but not a positive CPU identity record and BLAS/LAPACK implementation metadata.
blocking_findings.risk: The future physical execution would not satisfy the frozen machine-environment provenance requirement.
blocking_findings.closure_condition: Record CPU/platform identity plus NumPy/SciPy BLAS/LAPACK configuration in the immutable runtime attestation.

nonblocking_findings.title: DEPENDENCY_LOCK_PATH_SEMANTIC_ALIAS
nonblocking_findings.observed: WP2 names the Background3B dependency-lock path whereas the frozen Resource Policy names Background3C. Both files currently resolve to the same Git blob 2c3a8126fc5ec23bd82f0e99d6922610d9250bfc and therefore the same bytes.
nonblocking_findings.required_action: Normalize the canonical path during hardening to avoid future semantic drift even though no present dependency-byte mismatch exists.

nonblocking_findings.title: RAW_QUARANTINE_PATH_REQUIRES_EXPLICIT_PROMOTION_PROTOCOL
nonblocking_findings.observed: WP2 stages future raw execution outside the repository, while the frozen Result Schema defines a canonical immutable artifacts/hzt-m0/md2s/background3c/<run_id>/<authorization_decision_id>/ package.
nonblocking_findings.required_action: Define an explicit lossless promotion/packaging step or make the external transaction directory mirror the canonical result package before release.
